resident_sampling: 3 fresh workflow processes, first invocation then 3 measured repeats per case (9 repeats total). Multi-backend runs rotated backend order; DexSQL used three fresh processes sequentially. No separate discarded warm-up. ASC and ddc can reparse on a repeated query.
droidsaw_sampling: 3 independent CLI invocations per completed case (one first plus two repeats); each includes input loading. Two-hop and string+call each tested once with a shared 60-second deadline over composed calls.

sql.class: SELECT descriptor FROM classes WHERE descriptor = 'Lcom/tencent/mobileqq/activity/SplashActivity;'
sql.method: SELECT DISTINCT class_descriptor FROM class_methods WHERE method_name LIKE '%matchPayload%' ORDER BY class_descriptor
sql.string: SELECT DISTINCT method_class FROM method_strings WHERE value = 'closeQuietly(): Exception when connHttp.getInputStream()!,There may be no network, or no INTERNET permission' ORDER BY method_class
sql.string_call:
SELECT DISTINCT m.descriptor
FROM methods AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM method_strings AS s
        WHERE s.file_id = m.file_id AND s.method_idx = m.method_idx
          AND s.value = 'gifFilePath gifPath:'
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM method_calls AS c
        WHERE c.file_id = m.file_id AND c.method_idx = m.method_idx
          AND c.callee_class = 'Landroid/graphics/Bitmap;'
          AND c.callee_name = 'getWidth'
          AND c.callee = 'Landroid/graphics/Bitmap;->getWidth()I'
      )
ORDER BY m.descriptor;
sql.four_fact:
SELECT DISTINCT m.descriptor, m.class_descriptor
FROM methods AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM method_strings AS s
        WHERE s.file_id = m.file_id AND s.method_idx = m.method_idx
          AND s.value = 'gifFilePath gifPath:'
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM method_calls AS c
        WHERE c.file_id = m.file_id AND c.method_idx = m.method_idx
          AND c.callee = 'Landroid/graphics/Bitmap;->getWidth()I'
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM method_field_accesses AS f
        WHERE f.file_id = m.file_id AND f.method_idx = m.method_idx
          AND f.field_class = 'Landroid/graphics/Point;'
          AND f.field_name = 'x'
          AND f.field_type = 'I'
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM method_using_numbers AS n
        WHERE n.file_id = m.file_id AND n.method_idx = m.method_idx
          AND n.long_value = 99
      )
ORDER BY m.descriptor;
sql.complex:
WITH
string_groups AS (
    SELECT file_id, class_idx, method_idx, method,
           COUNT(DISTINCT value) AS invariant_count
    FROM method_strings
    WHERE value IN ('ByteUnitConvertUtils', 'GB', 'KB', 'MB')
    GROUP BY file_id, class_idx, method_idx, method
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT value) = 4
),
signature_pool AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT file_id, class_idx, method_idx, descriptor AS method
    FROM methods
    WHERE access_flags IS NOT NULL
      AND return_descriptor = 'Ljava/lang/String;'
      AND param_count = 2
      AND param_descriptors = 'J,Z'
),
set_candidates AS (
    SELECT file_id, class_idx, method_idx, method FROM string_groups
    INTERSECT
    SELECT file_id, class_idx, method_idx, method FROM signature_pool
    EXCEPT
    SELECT file_id, class_idx, method_idx, method
    FROM method_strings
    WHERE value = '__round13_impossible_bad_marker__'
),
shared AS (
    SELECT c.file_id, c.class_idx, c.method_idx, c.method
    FROM set_candidates c
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM method_calls mc
        WHERE mc.file_id = c.file_id
          AND mc.class_idx = c.class_idx
          AND mc.method_idx = c.method_idx
          AND mc.callee = 'Ljava/lang/Math;->round(D)J'
    )
),
field_consumer AS (
    SELECT s.file_id, s.class_idx, s.method_idx, s.method
    FROM shared s
    WHERE (s.file_id, s.class_idx, s.method_idx) IN (
        SELECT fa.file_id, fa.class_idx, fa.method_idx
        FROM method_field_accesses fa
        WHERE fa.field = 'Ljava/math/RoundingMode;->HALF_UP:Ljava/math/RoundingMode;'
        GROUP BY fa.file_id, fa.class_idx, fa.method_idx
        HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
    )
),
call_consumer AS (
    SELECT s.file_id, s.class_idx, s.method_idx, s.method
    FROM shared s
    WHERE (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM method_calls mc
        WHERE mc.file_id = s.file_id
          AND mc.class_idx = s.class_idx
          AND mc.method_idx = s.method_idx
          AND mc.callee IN (
              'Ljava/lang/Math;->round(D)J',
              'Ljava/text/DecimalFormat;->format(J)Ljava/lang/String;'
          )
    ) >= 2
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM method_strings bad
          WHERE bad.file_id = s.file_id
            AND bad.class_idx = s.class_idx
            AND bad.method_idx = s.method_idx
            AND bad.value = '__round13_excluded__'
      )
),
merged AS (
    SELECT file_id, class_idx, method_idx, method FROM field_consumer
    UNION
    SELECT file_id, class_idx, method_idx, method FROM call_consumer
)
SELECT DISTINCT m.method
FROM merged m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM field_consumer f
    WHERE f.file_id = m.file_id
      AND f.class_idx = m.class_idx
      AND f.method_idx = m.method_idx
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM call_consumer c
    WHERE c.file_id = m.file_id
      AND c.class_idx = m.class_idx
      AND c.method_idx = m.method_idx
)
ORDER BY m.method
sql.callers: SELECT DISTINCT method FROM method_calls WHERE callee = 'Liu3/a;->a(JZ)Ljava/lang/String;' ORDER BY method
sql.twohop: WITH first_hop AS (SELECT DISTINCT method FROM method_calls WHERE callee = 'Liu3/a;->a(JZ)Ljava/lang/String;') SELECT DISTINCT c.method FROM method_calls c JOIN first_hop f ON c.callee=f.method ORDER BY c.method

memory_sampling: 50 ms wait between polling passes. Sampling work and OS scheduling add to the actual interval; brief peaks may be missed. RSS sums process working sets and can double-count shared pages. Private Bytes is Windows committed private memory, not RSS.
garlic_sampling: Separate three-round run on the same machine and APK. Each round creates a new call graph and imports a new database. One first query then three repeats per case; charts use nine repeats. Every tool call uses a fresh MCP process because a second tools/call in one released server process exited. Query timers include server launch, initialization, DuckDB subprocesses, decoding, normalization, sorting and shutdown. The database is reused on disk. Graph generation and import are preparation costs.

garlic_threads.call_graph: Serial APK/DEX traversal in the tested release; no thread argument in MCP tool

garlic_sql.class: SELECT DISTINCT split_part(method_raw, '->', 1) AS value FROM java_cg_nodes WHERE starts_with(method_raw, 'Lcom/tencent/mobileqq/activity/SplashActivity;->') ORDER BY value
garlic_sql.method: SELECT DISTINCT split_part(method_raw, '->', 1) AS value FROM java_cg_nodes WHERE lower(split_part(split_part(method_raw, '->', 2), '(', 1)) LIKE '%matchpayload%' ORDER BY value
garlic_sql.string: SELECT DISTINCT split_part(n.method_raw, '->', 1) AS value FROM string_nodes s JOIN string_edges e ON e.string_id=s.id JOIN java_cg_nodes n ON n.node_id=e.method_id WHERE s.str='closeQuietly(): Exception when connHttp.getInputStream()!,There may be no network, or no INTERNET permission' ORDER BY value
garlic_sql.callers: SELECT DISTINCT caller.method_raw AS value FROM java_cg_edges e JOIN java_cg_nodes caller ON caller.node_id=e.src_id JOIN java_cg_nodes callee ON callee.node_id=e.dst_id WHERE callee.method_raw='Liu3/a;->a(JZ)Ljava/lang/String;' ORDER BY value
garlic_sql.twohop: WITH first_hop AS (SELECT DISTINCT caller.method_raw AS value FROM java_cg_edges e JOIN java_cg_nodes caller ON caller.node_id=e.src_id JOIN java_cg_nodes callee ON callee.node_id=e.dst_id WHERE callee.method_raw='Liu3/a;->a(JZ)Ljava/lang/String;') SELECT DISTINCT caller.method_raw AS value FROM java_cg_edges e JOIN java_cg_nodes caller ON caller.node_id=e.src_id JOIN java_cg_nodes callee ON callee.node_id=e.dst_id JOIN first_hop f ON f.value=callee.method_raw ORDER BY value
garlic_sql.string_call: SELECT DISTINCT n.method_raw AS value FROM string_nodes s JOIN string_edges se ON se.string_id=s.id JOIN java_cg_nodes n ON n.node_id=se.method_id JOIN java_cg_edges ce ON ce.src_id=n.node_id JOIN java_cg_nodes callee ON callee.node_id=ce.dst_id WHERE s.str='gifFilePath gifPath:' AND callee.method_raw='Landroid/graphics/Bitmap;->getWidth()I' ORDER BY value
